evidence.quote: half price at two in the afternoon
At close nobody is left to buy them.

observations.why: Price is set by time-of-day and sell-through consequence (no buyers left at close), a proportional cost/choice framing rather than rank, pooling, or reciprocity.

evidence.quote: so the price is never a surprise at the till

observations.why: Shelf-card change is justified as making price known before the purchase choice, a consequence-for-choice framing of pricing.
